# Luminal Factory Commerce

`AGENTS.md` is canonical. Follow its Ecommerce identity, architecture, security/live-approval, roadmap, validation, and PR rules. Use `.agents/skills/luminal-commerce/SKILL.md` as the workflow router. This is a Next.js 16 App Router storefront, not a cloning template or the ERP. Consult installed Next.js docs for changed APIs and run `npm run check` before delivery.
